text:
Priya Kapoor: Quick sync 5m - CloudRange QBR on Wed 3pm PT. Need final MDF split, partner scorecard snapshot and a one-slide co-sell play overview by EOD Thurs. Who picks which deliverable?

Tom Nguyen: I can take MDF numbers. Quick q: contract references $60k MDF + $15k co-sell credits; do we treat credits as separate from MDF?

Sara Blake: Yes separate. Co-sell credits are non-MDF. Also CloudRange HW promo promised a $12k booth subsidy outside MDF.

Priya Kapoor: Good to know. Treat MDF pot as $60k for allocations. Draft proposal below 50% split to start, please tweak: 

``
MDF allocation (total $60,000)
- Demand gen (paid ads + lead nurture): $22,000
- Field + events (booth, travel, logistics): $14,000
- Enablement (training + demo credits): $8,000
- Content & case study production: $6,000
- Performance holdback: $10,000
```

Kevin O'Leary: I prefer a slightly smaller performance holdback (5k) and more to events if PoC thresholds are hit. But 10k holdback is OK if tied to 2 PoCs and 1 customer reference.

Ella Martinez: I9ll update the slide deck and own the event ask. Can someone drop the latest partner scorecard numbers for the last 90d? Need ARR influence, joint pipeline, and active opportunities for slide 3.

Tom Nguyen: Pasting raw exports (90d):

``
partner,arr_influence,joint_pipeline,active_opps
CloudRange,360000,150000,3
CloudRange_HW,0,12000,0
```

Sara Blake: I'll normalize and produce a small CSV and commentary on partner engagement level. Will mark handoff points for SDR -> AM.

PartnerOpsBot: Reminder: QBR template v3 uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/partners/QBR_Template_v3.pptx

Priya Kapoor: @Kevin 5 can you confirm named SAM coverage so we can show ownership?

Kevin O'Leary: Confirmed. SAMs assigned: Rachel Li (West), Omar Ruiz (East). I'll add bullets on our co-sell motion and next steps.

Tom Nguyen: Ops note: any MDF line > $20k needs finance pre-approval. Who in Finance should we loop in?

Priya Kapoor: Looping Maya. Maya 5 can you pre-approve subject to SOW and invoicing plan?

Maya Singh: Maya Singh: I can provisionally approve the $60k with a $10k holdback contingent on signed SOW and 30-day reconciliation post-QBR. Please provide invoice schedule and PoC acceptance criteria.

Ella Martinez: I'll schedule a dry-run on Mon 30m. Invite: Priya, Tom, Kevin, Sara, CloudRange AM.

Tom Nguyen: I'll update the partner portal and attach the SOW draft once Priya posts it.

Priya Kapoor: Drafting SOW now; will ping for reviews tomorrow AM. Thanks team 5 trying to lock by EOD Thurs so marketing can finalize creative.

PartnerOpsBot: Actions created: [MDF allocation -> Tom], [Scorecard normalize -> Sara], [Deck + events slide -> Ella], [SOW draft -> Priya]. Due: EOD Thurs.

Kevin O'Leary: :thumbsup:

Sara Blake: Will post the normalized CSV in #partnerships when ready.

Priya Kapoor: If anything blocks, flag here. Otherwise we9ll aim for the dry-run on Monday.
